action.G03.objective.std: Take the shopping to Gran the way she wants it done in quarantine.
action.G05.objective.std: Have a look at the device in Gran’s garden workshop.
action.G06.objective.std: Find out what’s making noises in the workshop.
action.G07.objective.std: Find out why the device isn’t working.
action.G08.objective.std: Get a spare fuse with the same rating.
action.G09.objective.std: Replace the fuse in the device.
action.G10.objective.std: Connect the three reference shapes the device is asking for.
action.G11.objective.std: In 1995, find someone who knows ZVON. The sticker on the case says ‘Sokolíkova 1995’.
action.C01.objective.std: Get what Mira asked for: a photo of today’s school yard and her technical property from the school.
action.D01.objective.std: Collect Mira’s technical property from the school.
action.D02.objective.std: Find out what’s left of Oto’s bridge.
action.D03.003.std: The chronometer reacts to that date. I need a place that remembers that year.
action.D04.objective.std: In 1982, find Oto and twelve-year-old Tóno.
action.D05.objective.std: Get the bridge out of the jar and show it to Tóno.
action.D07.objective.std: Sort out the paperwork for moving Mira’s box.
action.C02.objective.std: Get the signature of the person who collected the box.
action.C03.objective.std: The record still needs its second signature.
action.C04.objective.std: Find out what Gran’s device makes of the confirmed handover.
action.Q2A.002.std: I’ll sort it out. On paper, in large print. Somebody round here writes those notices, after all.
look.S03.supplies.std: Ela has names and recipients’ consent for every bag. Under the list there’s a stack of neighbourhood help notices in three sizes.
action.B01.objective.std: Report to the school the way the notice asks.
action.B02.k02.std: They still have belts at repair shops where nothing gets thrown away. The tram will take you to one before you’ve finished your packed lunch.
action.B02.objective.std: Find the club that’s looking for a repairer.
action.B04.002.std: It’s completely perished. I won’t find a belt like that at a stationer’s – only at a repair shop where nothing gets thrown away.
action.B04.objective.std: Get a new drive belt of the same size.
action.B05.k03.std: To the people who listen to hiss as if it were music. They meet in a basement in Ružinov, and one of them works magic with tapes.
action.B05.objective.std: Fit the new drive belt into the tape recorder.
action.B06.k01.std: Pali mentioned someone who works magic with tapes. He might know.
action.B06.objective.std: Find someone who can save the voices on the tape.
action.B07.x01.std: Hi. They say someone here works magic with tapes. I need you to listen to this cassette.
action.B07.003.std: Here’s a cross adaptor. You’ll find a two-pin connector at the market with the parts and the stories, and the missing insulation at a tailor’s who sews coats and cables alike.
action.B07.x03.std: And will they know what it’s about?
action.B07.x04.std: At the market they sold me my first Walkman, and the tailor next door sewed up my headphone cable. Tell them I sent you.
action.B07.objective.std: Get a connector and insulation for the adaptor.
action.B11.objective.std: Try the lead where the cassette can be played.
action.B13.003.std: A transparent overlay was separated from it at some point. Its number is on the negative; you just need to read it in a print.
action.B13.k01.std: Someone will have to develop the negative for you. They still know how on the square; you just have to look for the light.
action.B13.objective.std: Find out the number of the missing overlay from the negative.
action.B14.003.std: Here’s the print. The number on the table is K-17. Map supplements tend to drift around second-hand bookshops. The negative goes back to the archive.
action.B14.objective.std: Find the transparent overlay with the number K-17.
action.B15.objective.std: Put the whole map of measuring nodes together.
action.B16.objective.std: Find out what the places on the map mean.
action.B17.003.std: A metronome would be better. Every decent musician carries one, even the one who plays to the trams. Mira drew the three digits on a wall for the children.
action.B17.004.std: A wall with pictures. There are more of those in Dúbravka than you’d like. At one of them, as a schoolboy, I looked for a ball until dark.
action.B17.objective.std: Get a mechanical rhythm and find the three digits Mira drew on a wall.
look.S19.EMIL.std: Emil keeps the tempo, even when the city around him doesn’t. A metronome ticks along on his case.
action.B18.objective.std: Set up the measurement on Starý most.
action.B19.objective.std: I’ve written down the digits 3–2–6. Now I need to find where they’re set.
action.B22.k01.std: Gran said she built ZVON with Oto Bielik, a mechanic from Ivanka. In a village you find the mechanic by the sound.
action.B22.objective.std: Go to Ivanka in 1962 and find Oto Bielik.
action.E10.objective.std: Check in 1995 whether Tóno remembers the agreement.
action.Q3A.001.std: Our team photo got lost somewhere between the studio and the kiosk. They say the kiosk finds everything. Except our photo.
action.Q3B.001.std: Soňa sent you? Here you are, the envelope with the team negative. You won’t see anything on it until it’s developed.
action.Q4A.001.std: ‘Four Stops’, my song. I wrote the ending in a book and sold the book to the second-hand bookshop. They say books don’t vanish there; they just wait.
action.Q5A.002.std: White chalk by the box… That rings a bell.
action.Q5A.003.std: But only with permission, please. I don’t want anywhere to be short of anything because of me.
action.Q11A.objective.std: Find the cap of Kubo’s bell.
action.Q11B.objective.std: Put the cap back on Kubo’s bell.
action.I01.003.std: Mira is with the device. First, repair the hand pump. Here’s a slip; they’ll issue the leather and rivets in the yard. The people sewing costumes in the hall have a punch.
action.I01.x07.std: And bring the punch back to me afterwards. I’ll return it myself – borrowed things go back through me here.
action.I01.objective.std: Repair the hand pump: you need a cuff, rivets and a punch.
action.I06.objective.std: Let Oto know the pump is drawing.
action.I09.005.std: Make an imprint of the plate. You need waxed paper and something blunt that won’t scratch. Here’s a registration form. An official has to confirm the date. We’ll file the copy.
action.I09.objective.std: Make a legible imprint of the plate and have the registration form officially confirmed, in duplicate.
action.I16.objective.std: Store the documents where Mira wants them kept safe.
action.E01.objective.std: Prove to Tóno where you’ve come from.
action.E02.k01.std: Take the slip to the store. They’ll issue everything that’s written on it, and not a screw more.
action.E02.objective.std: Make a spare bridge and hide it with Tóno so that it lasts until 2020.
action.E08.objective.std: Make sure the young lime tree survives.
action.Q6A.001.std: Béla stayed behind in the park and won’t touch ordinary grain. His mix is issued wherever everything in Ivanka is issued against a slip.
action.Q10A.objective.std: Get a bit of leather for the loop.
action.F01.005.std: Viktor Korman, our founder. I warned him, but he didn’t switch it off. To get into the pavilion you need a cassette reader, the collection card, a service pass and a ticket.
action.F01.x05.std: A reader, a card, a pass. Where do I get them?
action.F01.x06.std: In the hotel, ask whoever does repairs and whoever guards the boxes. And tickets are sold where tickets are sold.
action.F01.objective.std: Get a reader, the card for collection Z-17, a service pass and a cable car ticket.
action.F03.x07.std: Thank you. With the card I can ask about a pass.
action.F03.objective.std: Get a service pass and a cable car ticket.
action.F04.objective.std: Take the cable car to the pavilion.
action.J04.objective.std: By the Rotunda, look at what Atlas shows the public, then go to the service pavilion.
action.F06.objective.std: Capture the local reference trace by Vrbické pleso.
action.F07.objective.std: Bring the reference trace to the pavilion.

action.Q5A.journal.std: Juraj has run out of white chalk for his map of lights. Apparently schools buy the white by the box.
action.Q6A.journal.std: Alojz’s pigeon Béla stayed behind in the park. He needs his own mix.
action.Q7A.journal.std: Rudo lent his script to Mira to rest her drawings on.
